headline.text: L3 ML4 gondola was down *5+ hours* on a belt-sync fault — maintenance still troubleshooting at window close.

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran all three Sollich lines but hit a 26-minute tray outage on S2 mid-shift that cleared when the truck arrived. S2 also lost 90 minutes in the morning to a Cavanna 3 printer fault that Troy traced to a disabled recipe setting. S3 took two planned CILT stops for roller cleaning, both under 30 minutes.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 ran ML3 and grinding with no line breaks. One roof leak flagged in the GMP area during rain, bucket placed. Scrap entry missed in safety chain on grinding.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 lost over 5 hours to a gondola belt-sync fault starting at 04:47 that caused bars to break at infeed — Kavin and Nelson worked it through first shift with no clear resolution by 11:05. ML1 had two dosing-block clogs that cleared inside 30 minutes total and a buffer-tank temp issue that needed a new control unit but resolved. MF Matrix pouching line is skipping product dumps on 50%+ of pouches due to a vacuum-seal trigger fault, still live at window close. Truffle line paused 105 minutes overnight to refill a low buffer tank.

notes.text: Ethan secured 24 pallets of item 40694-V2 trays for delivery today and a full truckload Monday to cover the rest of September.
Multiple roof and window leaks reported during rain — two ceiling leaks by S1, water under roll-up door, and bay-door window seals failing.
Warehouse roof leaking in aisles 5 and 7, pallets moved, roofers to be contacted.

resolved.title: S2 ran out of trays mid-shift
resolved.summary: S2 line stopped at 17:53 when item 40694-V2 trays ran out — truck with resupply was en route from SV.
resolved.resolution: Trays arrived at 18:15, unloaded, and line restarted at 18:40. Downtime 26 minutes (Elizabeth Hernandez).

resolved.title: S2 Cavanna 3 printer not printing
resolved.summary: Cavanna 3 printer stopped working during Bucees setup at 05:54, maintenance and Troy troubleshooting through morning.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:47 — Troy found printer disabled in recipe settings, re-enabled. "Cavanna printer is working now" (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S3 CILT roller cleaning stops
resolved.summary: Planned downtime for CILT cleaning on rollers at start of tunnel 1, marshmallow area, and tracking roller.
resolved.resolution: All rollers cleaned and reinstalled by 10:47. "Line should be back up shortly" (Nathan Topham). Total downtime under 30 minutes.

resolved.title: ML1 buffer tank temperature controller failure
resolved.summary: Buffer tank setpoint at 55 would not rise, blocking tempering — maintenance replaced the temperature control unit.
resolved.resolution: Nathan Ruiz installed new temperature control unit at 09:35, temperature climbing normally. Confirmed good at 09:38.

resolved.title: ML4 TG5 conveyor belt ripped and fraying
resolved.summary: 270 belt on TG5 ripped and fraying on north side at 18:01, line stopped for replacement.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced by 20:09 — "TG5 belt was replaced we are starting it up now" (Shane Olsen).

resolved.title: Truffle line buffer tank empty due to melting tank temperature
resolved.summary: Buffer tank at 10% at 00:07, melting tank too cold to stir or send chocolate, line paused to refill.
resolved.resolution: Line stopped at 00:20, started filling buffer tank at 01:25, line restarted at 03:00. Total downtime 105 minutes.

resolved.title: Truffle line M3 belt stopping intermittently
resolved.summary: M3 conveyor belt kept stopping, maintenance called for adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance made adjustment, belt running again. Confirmed by Tyson Fausett and Bojana McLeod.

resolved.title: ML4 return pump breaker tripped
resolved.summary: Return pump faulted at 00:38, pipes warm, pump not running — safety concern for overfill.
resolved.resolution: Kavin Ayala found breaker tripped at 01:17, reset and pump running. Sensor had chocolate covering it, cleaned.

resolved.title: ML1 dosing block clogs, two occurrences
resolved.summary: Dosing block clogged at 02:48, cleared and restarted, then clogged again at 03:17 requiring 16-minute stop.
resolved.resolution: First clog cleared by 03:05, second cleared by 03:56. Line back up and running at 03:56 (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML1 molds not demolding at startup
resolved.summary: 25 molds failed to demold at 04:57, likely due to mold temperature at deposit start.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:09 — "Had 25 molds not demolding back running again" (Imperial).

resolved.title: ML1 C6 belt guide rail bracket failure
resolved.summary: C6 conveyor belt repeatedly moved off-center triggering alarms throughout the shift due to damaged guide rail bracket.
resolved.resolution: Nathan Ruiz repaired and reinstalled C6 guide rail bracket at 07:37. Belt centered and running well by 11:05 (Molding Line 1 Flow-Wrap).

needs_attention.title: S2 plow belt faulting and areas need re-cleaning
needs_attention.summary: Plow belt faulting during Bucees setup at 05:54, plus chicana band had unknown bag and label, several areas needed re-cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Product paused in tunnels at 05:54 while maintenance works on plow belt and areas re-cleaned. Printer issue resolved separately by 07:47.

needs_attention.title: S1 trays low inventory through weekend
needs_attention.summary: Item 40694-V2 trays at 4,820 count, need 8,180 more to cover Saturday 19th through Friday 25th — delivery scheduled but tight window.
needs_attention.status: Ethan secured 24 pallets (6,720 trays) arriving today to cover weekend and Monday, plus FTL Monday 7:30 AM for rest of month. Short-term risk if weekend volume spikes.

needs_attention.title: GMP area roof leak during rain
needs_attention.summary: Water leaking through GMP area roof when raining — bucket placed to catch water.
needs_attention.status: Alan Todd notified at 10:10, Dave Ruff and William Lopez to inspect this afternoon (10:33 William confirmed).

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix pouching machine skipping 50%+ product dumps
needs_attention.summary: Pouch machine not coordinating correctly — vacuum seal not triggering, causing pouches to open but not fill. Running at reduced speed (38-40 ppm) with high scrap rate.
needs_attention.status: Troy Baxter on-site troubleshooting as of 08:49. Physical alignment and setup good but vacuum seal not triggering dump. Slowed to 38 ppm, still missing pouches. Last update 10:43: "Did maintenance have any input on the vacuum pump not triggering?"

needs_attention.title: ML4 gondola belt unsynced with conveyor, breaking bars
needs_attention.summary: Gondola infeed belt became misaligned with conveyor at 04:47 causing continuous jams and broken bars — Kavin and Nelson troubleshooting through first shift with no resolution.
needs_attention.status: Line down since 04:47, ran intermittently with jams. Maintenance (Kavin, Nelson) still working at 06:36. CIL cleaning performed during downtime. No clear fix by window close at 11:05.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line wire belt turns on instead of off during reheat
needs_attention.summary: Bottomer reheat setting inverted — turns wire belt on when it should turn off.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 04:46 with photo. No follow-up on fix attempt by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 1 centerline out of date, mass supply alarm disabled
needs_attention.summary: Third shift using outdated centerline for depositor 1 — mass supply A minimum value set to 0%, disabling low-hopper alarm (safety issue).
needs_attention.status: Shawn flagged at 05:00. Operator changed mass supply A min back to 10% at 05:15. Kimberly printing correct centerline to show differences.

needs_attention.title: Truffle line changeover delayed — no clean towels, loose hardware
needs_attention.summary: Line stopped for changeover at 04:10 but found dirty, no clean towels available, multiple loose screws discovered during inspection.
needs_attention.status: Cleaning started 04:25 but only dishwash parts cleaned as of 05:37 due to no towels. Raoul confirmed limited rags available at 05:46. Safety meeting and LOTO completed, cleaning in progress at window close. Goal to start by 12:30.
